traits.label: Hymenium
traits.text: Smooth, without pores or gills; pale cream, buff to ochraceous; fresh surface characteristically stains bright yellow when scratched or bruised

traits.label: Cap
traits.text: Fan- to semicircular, thin and leathery, overlapping in tiers; concentrically zoned grey-yellow, ochre, buff to pale brown; finely velvety to tomentose, sometimes greenish from algae with age; margin thin and wavy
traits.raw: ℹ️ Cap: Fan- to semicircular, thin and leathery, overlapping in tiers; concentrically zoned grey-yellow, ochre, buff to pale brown; finely velvety to tomentose, sometimes greenish from algae with age; margin thin and wavy
